Author: Rongon Mukhopadhyay

In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 2374 of 2024

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
....Petitioner Versus
1. The State of Jharkhand.
2. Malika Sarkar, Wife of Manjeet Sarkar, daughter of Nirmal Sarkar, Resident of Patratu Basti,
Near Dr. Santana Saran Hospital, P.O. & P.S. Ramgarh, District-Ramgarh. .....Opposite Parties
----
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice Rongon Mukhopadhyay
-----
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Tiwary, Advocate
 For the State : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, A.P.P.
 For O.P. No. 2 : Mr. Shubhankar Dey, Advocate
 -----
05/13.9.2024
The petitioner apprehends his arrest in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No. 23 of 2023.
It has been alleged that after the marriage of the petitioner was solemnized with the informant she was subjected to torture and assault as a result of non fulfillment of demand of Rs.3,00,000/-.

Submission has been advanced by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner is the husband of the informant and infact prior to the institution of the criminal case against the petitioner he had already filed a suit for restitution of conjugal rights being Original Suit No. 516 of 2023 which would show the inclination of the petitioner to keep the informant with him with full dignity and honor.

entities.text: Manjeet Sarkar vs The State Of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Mr. Shubhankar Dey, learned counsel appearing for the informant, has opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail of the petitioner and has submitted that the petitioner has a criminal antecedent as he is involved in a case registered under sections 406, 419, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code, to which Mr. Tiwary has submitted that the same was filed by the brother of the petitioner.

Considering the fact that the suit for restitution of conjugal rights has already been preferred by the petitioner and the allegations being general and omnibus in nature, I am inclined to extend the privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.
Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to surrender in the court below within a period of four weeks from today and on his surrender/arrest, he will be enlarged on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- ( Ten thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ramgarh in connection with Mahila P.S. Case No.
23 of 2023, subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.

(Rongon Mukhopadhyay, J) Rakesh/-
